metadata.name: Job Description
metadata.value:
Role Overview 

We are seeking a highly skilled AI Trainer to deliver world-class training programs in Applied AI, Agentic AI, and Generative AI. The ideal candidate is a passionate educator with deep hands-on expertise in modern AI technologies, strong communication skills, and proven experience in corporate or professional training environments. 

This role will focus primarily on training delivery, content development, and supporting presales conversations for AI skilling programs across enterprise and academic clients. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Training Delivery (Primary Focus — 60–70%) 

Deliver high-quality, instructor-led trainings (virtual and in-person) on: 

Artificial Intelligence (AI) 

Agentic AI 

Generative AI 

AI for Engineering, Development, Data related roles.  

Foundational ML concepts 

Conduct customized corporate workshops, hands-on bootcamps, hackathons, and upskilling sessions. 

Ensure high learner satisfaction through engaging, practical, and real-world teaching methods. 

2. Curriculum & Content Development 

Design and maintain training modules, labs, and assessments for AI, Agentic AI, and GenAI courses. 

Translate complex technical concepts into learner-friendly material. 

Continuously update content with the latest industry trends, tools, and best practices. 

Contribute to building a scalable AI course catalog for enterprises and universities. 

3. Pre-Sales & Solutioning Support (20–30%) 

Work with sales teams to scope client AI training needs. 

Provide thought leadership during client discussions and solutioning. 

Help create proposals, training plans, and learning journey maps for enterprise clients. 

4. Portfolio Enhancement & Innovation 

Introduce new training formats, hands-on labs, case studies, and real-world project scenarios. 

Collaborate with internal SMEs and academic partners for curriculum alignment. 

Participate in Train-the-Trainer (T3) initiatives. 

 

Required Skills & Experience 

Professional Experience 

8–12 years total experience in AI/ML, software engineering, or data-related fields. 

Minimum 4–6 years of experience as a corporate trainer, instructor, or technical educator. 

2–3 years hands-on experience in building AI/ML or GenAI-based solutions (industry, consulting, or project work). 

Proven track record of delivering technical trainings to enterprise or university audiences. 

Technical Expertise 

Strong foundation in AI/ML concepts, LLMs, prompt engineering, and GenAI workflows. 

Good understanding of Agentic AI, including building agents using frameworks like LangChain, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude, OpenAI API, or similar tools. 

Proficiency with: 

Python 

AI/ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn) 

GenAI toolsets (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, vector databases, RAG pipelines) 

Experience with at least one major cloud: Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

Ability to build and demonstrate hands-on labs, notebooks, and real-world examples. 

Authorized Instructor for any cloud services provider will be an added advantage 

Training & Communication Skills 

Exceptional presentation, communication, and facilitation skills. 

Ability to explain technical concepts to audiences at different skill levels. 

Comfortable managing large groups and interactive sessions. 

 

Nice-to-Have 

Experience developing structured learning journeys or training paths for enterprises. 

Certifications in AI/ML, cloud AI services, or instructional design. 

Experience participating in RFPs for learning programs.

metadata.name: Job Description
metadata.value:
The Business Development Director for Xebia training services team will drive revenue growth, market expansion, and strategic partnerships for a leading IT Training and Certification company in the USA and Canada. This sales manager role requires deep expertise in Enterprise skilling with prior experience with hyperscaler’s like Microsoft, GCP, Databricks, Github technologies, and a proven track record of building and executing high-impact business development strategies. The Director will be responsible for the full sales lifecycle, from prospecting and solution development to closing and account management, ensuring the company’s position as a premier provider of Enterprise training solutions across Americas.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Market Development
Develop and execute comprehensive business development and go-to-market strategies to expand Xebia’s training services business across enterprise, government, and education sectors in the USA and Canada.
Identify new market opportunities, emerging industry trends, and competitive threats to inform strategic decision-making and ensure sustained business growth.
Lead systematic prospect targeting, opportunity qualification, and sales pipeline management to achieve ambitious revenue and growth targets.
Sales Leadership & Execution
Own the sales process end-to-end: prospecting, needs analysis, solution design, proposal development, presentations, negotiations, and closing.
Build and maintain a robust pipeline, leveraging CRM tools and data analytics for accurate forecasting and performance tracking.
Collaborate with marketing, product, and delivery teams to align offerings with market demand and ensure seamless customer experiences.
Relationship & Partnership Management
Establish and nurture executive-level relationships with key clients, Alliance stakeholders, channel partners, and industry associations.
Negotiate and secure high-value contracts, strategic alliances, and co-delivery partnerships to expand reach and impact.
Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and technology forums to enhance brand visibility and thought leadership.
Training Portfolio & Solution Expertise
Deeply understand partner training ecosystem including AI, Agentic AI, Data, Developer and cloud technologies for enterprise skilling,
Work with curriculum and delivery teams to introduce innovative training programs, including instructor-led, virtual, blended, and self-paced learning solutions partner, certification changes, and digital learning trends to ensure the company’s offerings remain best-in-class.
Team Leadership & Mentorship
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing business development and sales team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Set clear performance goals, provide ongoing coaching, and drive accountability for results.
Skills, Experience, and Knowledge Required
Area
Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, IT, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
Experience
7-8+ years in business development, preferably hunting role with farming ability, sales management, Account management and strategic partnerships within IT trainings. Prior experience in partner ecosystem like Microsoft, Google, Databricks, GitHub, AWS will be an added advantage.
Industry Knowledge
Familiarity with training industry trends, digital learning modalities, and certification frameworks in the Digital & AI, Data, Cloud, Engineering and Transformation
Sales & Business Acumen
Proven ability to develop and execute sales strategies, manage complex sales cycles, and close large enterprise deals. Strong analytical, financial, and forecasting skills.
Relationship Management
Exceptional networking, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills at the C-suite and senior executive level. Experience forming strategic partnerships and alliances.
Communication
Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills; ability to articulate complex solutions and value propositions to diverse audiences.
Technical Skills
Proficiency in Hubspot CRM and sales enablement tools, digital marketing platforms, and business analytics.
Leadership
Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring teams, driving cross-functional collaboration, and fostering high-performance cultures.
